aboutCompany: Reports, contacts and projects for this company.
companyGone: This company is no longer available.
companyGoneMeans: It may have been archived or handed to somebody else. Everything that is yours is in the list.
companyFailed: This company could not be opened.
dispatchFailed: This dispatch could not be opened.
emptyActivity: No report yet — add the first visit or call.
emptyContacts: No contacts yet — add the person you deal with.
emptyProjects: No projects yet — add the first project at this company.
followUpClearedProject: The company’s date is cleared. {project} still has its own.
projectDrivesFollowUp: {project} is due {date}. The Companies list shows the earlier of the two — the date above is the company’s own.
archiveReasonPlaceholder: Closed down; merged into another company; a duplicate
archiveWarning: The company leaves your lists but keeps its history. An admin can restore it.
archiveContactWarning: The contact leaves this company’s list. Everything they were named in keeps their name.
archiveProjectWarning: The project leaves your lists and keeps its history. This is not the same as marking it lost — a lost project stays, with its reason.
handOverWarning: Their projects, open quotations and dispatches move with the company. What was already approved stays counted in the month of the person it was requested for, and the reports stay as they were written.
handOverNobody: Nobody else can hold a company.

share.companyTitle: The other people on this company
share.companyMeans: Everyone here reads the company and everything under it, and keeps their own contacts on it. Nobody else works it: sharing is not a hand over, and the company stays with its rep.
share.companyNobody: Nobody else is on this company.
share.projectTitle: The other people on this project
share.projectMeans: Everyone here works the project: writes reports on it, and requests quotations and dispatches on it. What they request stays theirs, and the project itself belongs to whoever added it.
share.projectNobody: Nobody else is on this project.
share.nobodyLeft: No one else can be added.
share.removeCompanyWarning: This person stops seeing the company and everything under it, and comes off every project of its they were on. Their own contacts, and everything they wrote, stay.
share.removeProjectWarning: This person stops working the project and still reads the company. The quotations, dispatches and reports they raised stay as they are.
share.leaveCompanyWarning: Sharing ends. The company and everything under it stop showing on your lists, and every project of its you were on comes off with it. The contacts you added and everything you wrote stay.
share.leaveProjectWarning: The project stops being yours to work: no more reports, quotations or dispatches on it from you. You still read the company, and the quotations, dispatches and reports you raised stay as they are.

unfileWarning: It leaves this company’s history and every count that included it. Nothing is deleted, and there is no putting it back — write the report where it belongs.
